name: Silky
source:
Silky is a compassionate Dark Lord that urged Demon King Gi to release Humanity from the slavery and oppression that had been established by Gele for over 1,000 years. She was born as a common human near the end of Gele's era or right at the very start of Gi's era. Despite the fact that Gi had replaced the previous ruthless Gele that reduced humans to cattle, not much had changed for humanity as Gi didn't make attempt to change anything that had been established by her. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/La_Saizel]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
